**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — no redline, no comment (correct output for a compliant finding; paragraphs remain unchanged).

Repairs made:
- **Removed p0118 from the cited paragraphs** and addressed the deterministic hit head-on: the only 90-day figure (§17(b)) is *Sparkling's* termination-for-convenience notice right, a customer-side exit benefit — not a non-renewal notice window binding us. Per direction rules, it is not flagged.
- **Tightened the compliance basis**: §10 (p0065) gives a "renewable one-year term" with no "automatically renew" or "unless either party gives notice … days prior" language anywhere in the document, so renewal requires mutual agreement in 12-month periods — the preferred position. No notice window exists to measure, so neither the ≤60-day fallback nor the >90-day/multi-year walk-away is engaged.
- **Retained as a rationale note only**: no CPI/3% cap on maintenance fee uplift (§11 cross-refers to the Fee Schedule), which the playbook treats as a sub-element rather than a deviation.
